title: Text 1
subtitle: 自动化时代中产阶级就业之困

sentences.en: Among the annoying challenges facing the middle class is one that will probably go unmentioned in the next presidential campaign: What happens when the robots come for their jobs?
sentences.zh: 在中产阶级面临的各种恼人挑战中，有一个挑战很可能在下届总统竞选中被忽略：当机器人来抢他们的饭碗时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Don't dismiss that possibility entirely.
sentences.zh: 不要完全否定这种可能性。

sentences.en: About half of U.S. jobs are at high risk of being automated, according to a University of Oxford study, with the middle class disproportionately squeezed.
sentences.zh: 根据牛津大学的一项研究，美国大约一半的工作岗位面临被自动化取代的高风险，中产阶级受到的挤压尤为严重。

sentences.en: Lower-income jobs like gardening or day care don't appeal to robots.
sentences.zh: 园艺、日托等低收入工作对机器人没有吸引力。

sentences.en: But many middle-class occupations — trucking, financial advice, software engineering — have aroused their interest, or soon will.
sentences.zh: 但许多中产阶级职业——货运、金融咨询、软件工程——已经引起（或即将引起）机器人的兴趣。

sentences.en: The rich own the robots, so they will be fine.
sentences.zh: 富人拥有机器人，所以他们不会有问题。

sentences.en: This isn't to be alarmist.
sentences.zh: 这并非危言耸听。

sentences.en: Optimists point out that technological upheaval has benefited workers in the past.
sentences.zh: 乐观主义者指出，过去的技术剧变曾使工人受益。

sentences.en: The Industrial Revolution didn't go so well for Luddites whose jobs were displaced by mechanized looms, but it eventually raised living standards and created more jobs than it destroyed.
sentences.zh: 工业革命对卢德分子并不友好，他们的工作被机械化织布机所取代，但工业革命最终提高了生活水平，创造的就业机会比破坏的多。

sentences.en: Likewise, automation should eventually boost productivity, stimulate demand by driving down prices, and free workers from hard, boring work.
sentences.zh: 同样，自动化最终应该能够提高生产率，通过压低价格刺激需求，并把工人从辛苦乏味的工作中解放出来。

sentences.en: But in the medium term, middle-class workers may need a lot of help adjusting.
sentences.zh: 但从中期来看，中产阶级工人可能需要大量帮助来适应这一变化。

sentences.en: The first step, as Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee argue in The Second Machine Age, should be rethinking education and job training.
sentences.zh: 正如埃里克·布林约尔松和安德鲁·麦卡菲在《第二次机器革命》中所论证的那样，第一步应该是重新思考教育和职业培训。

sentences.en: Curriculums — from grammar school to college — should evolve to focus less on memorizing facts and more on creativity and complex communication.
sentences.zh: 从文法学校到大学的课程设置都应加以改进，从侧重死记硬背转向侧重创造力和复杂沟通。

sentences.en: Vocational schools should do a better job of fostering problem- solving skills and helping students work alongside robots.
sentences.zh: 职业学校应该更好地培养解决问题的能力，并帮助学生学会与机器人协作工作。

sentences.en: Online education can supplement the traditional kind.
sentences.zh: 在线教育可以补充传统教育。

sentences.en: It could make extra training and instruction affordable.
sentences.zh: 它可以使额外的培训和指导变得负担得起。

sentences.en: Professionals trying to acquire new skills will be able to do so without going into debt.
sentences.zh: 想要获得新技能的专业人士将能够在无需负债的情况下做到这一点。

sentences.en: The challenge of coping with automation underlines the need for the U.S. to revive its fading business dynamism: Starting new companies must be made easier.
sentences.zh: 应对自动化的挑战凸显了美国重振日渐衰退的商业活力的必要性：必须让创办新公司变得更加容易。

sentences.en: In previous eras of drastic technological change, entrepreneurs smoothed the transition by dreaming up ways to combine labor and machines.
sentences.zh: 在以往技术剧变的时代，企业家们通过想出各种将劳动力与机器结合起来的办法，使过渡得以平稳实现。

sentences.en: The best uses of 3D printers and virtual reality haven't been invented yet.
sentences.zh: 3D打印机和虚拟现实的最佳用途尚未被发明出来。

sentences.en: The U.S. needs the new companies that will invent them.
sentences.zh: 美国需要能够发明这些用途的新公司。

sentences.en: Finally, because automation threatens to widen the gap between capital income and labor income, taxes and the safety net will have to be rethought.
sentences.zh: 最后，由于自动化有可能扩大资本收入与劳动收入之间的差距，税收和社会保障体系将不得不重新考量。

sentences.en: Taxes on low-wage labor need to be cut, and wage subsidies such as the earned income tax credit should be expanded: This would boost incomes, encourage work, reward companies for job creation, and reduce inequality.
sentences.zh: 需要削减对低工资劳动力的税收，并扩大劳动所得税抵免等工资补贴：这将增加收入、鼓励就业、奖励公司创造就业岗位，并减少不平等。

sentences.en: Technology will improve society in ways big and small over the next few years, yet this will be little comfort to those who find their lives and careers upended by automation.
sentences.zh: 未来几年，技术将在大大小小的方面改善社会，但这对那些生活与事业被自动化颠覆的人来说，几乎起不到什么安慰作用。

sentences.en: Destroying the machines that are coming for our jobs would be nuts.
sentences.zh: 摧毁那些来抢我们工作的机器是疯狂之举。

sentences.en: But policies to help workers adapt will be indispensable.
sentences.zh: 但帮助工人适应的政策将是必不可少的。

questions.stem: Who will be most threatened by automation?
questions.analysis: 根据题干中“threatned”和“automation”定位到第一段首句“the annoyi-ng challenge facing the middle class is one that。。。for their jobs”中的challenge和第二段的最后三句话，可以得知相对于低收入者和富人，中产阶级受到的冲击最大。

questions.stem: Which of the following best represents the author’s view?

options.A: Worries about automation are in fact groundless.
options.B: Optimists’ opinions on new tech find little support.
options.C: Issues arising from automation need to be tackled.
options.D: Negative consequences of new tech can be avoided.

questions.analysis: 根据题干可定位到第三段中的首句“this isn’t to be alarmist”和末句“But 。。。 middle-class workers may need a lot of help adjusting”，but转折句再一次强调了作者的观点，即中产阶级工人需要很多帮助来调整应对问题。同时，末句中”may need a lot of help”同义替换成选项C中的“need to be tackled”，自动化带来的问题需要被解决，得出C答案。

questions.stem: Education in the age of automation should put more emphasis on ____
questions.analysis: 根据题干中的关键词可定位到第四段第二句“Curriculums—from grammar school to college—should evolve to focus less on memorizing facts and more on creativity and complex communication”。由该句可知，课程应该更关注创造性和复杂的沟通而非记忆事实。所以，应该选C选项creative potential（创造潜能），同义替换为creativity。

questions.stem: The author suggests that tax policies be aimed at ____

options.B: increasing the return on capital investment.
options.C: easing the hostility between rich and poor.
options.D: preventing the income gap from widening.

questions.analysis: 该题考查作者的观点，根据题干中的关键词可定位到第六段第一句“Finally， because automation threatens to widen the gap between capital income and labor income， taxes and the safety net will have to be rethought”。由该句可知，由于自动化加大了资本收入和劳动力收入的差距，所以应该重新考虑税收和安全网（保障措施），即税收政策应该避免收入差距扩大，选D选项preventing the income gap from widening。

questions.stem: In this text, the author presents a problem with ____
questions.analysis: 作者在文章第一、二段提出问题“中产阶级受自动化危害最大”之后，第三段的末尾句提出中产阶级需要帮助去适应自动化的发展，接下来第四段至第六段介绍解决方法，最后一段表明作者观点。所以应该选B 选项possible solutions to it（解决问题的相应方法）。
